definitions.total_integration_views: Observed playback events over the provider's measured lifetime window for tracked sponsored video integrations
definitions.attributed_clicks: Agentio-tracked sponsored offer click events, not unique customers
definitions.ctr: click-through rate of tagged sponsorship link/action, denominator is qualifying impressions or views subject to Agentio method; absolute baseline not reported here
definitions.conversion_rate: Advertiser-attributed conversion events per selected click or related measured denominator; absolute baseline and event definitions not sufficiently published to infer real revenue
definitions.cpm: Effective advertiser cost per thousand measured views, not creator cash profit or platform-native RPM

excluded_inferences: The 38% of views after 30 days and the ~30% of clicks after 30 days are different populations/units; dividing them does not yield CTR.
The 27% of views after 90 days is a subset of post-30-day views, not additive to 38%.
The eighth-placement 1.8x CTR and sixth-placement 1.9x CVR are relative cohort observations, not absolute CTR/CVR, verified incrementality or expected effects of a new creator.
Continuing sponsor relationships may be selected after earlier performance; correlation does not establish a causal benefit of repeating contracts.
A falling advertiser cumulative CPM after one year is not an increase in creator pay or a decline in creator expenses.
More than 10,000 paid selected placements are not all creator uploads, zero earners or the global YouTube advertising population.
The geographic breakdown describes the vendor's selected creators, not the distribution of YouTube creators or subscribers worldwide.
